rows.title: Notify the adjoining owner
rows.requirement: Written notice to the adjoining owner at least 60 days before work: the work, schedule, inspections or monitoring, protection, and a contact. A second notice if there is no reply.
rows.proof_needed: The notice letters and their dates

leads.document: Adjoining Owners Notification.pdf on DOB NOW, job B01330433, filing S3. The article describes it as a letter to neighboring landlords dated June 10.
leads.checked: Unread: DOB NOW's portal refused a teammate's script (HTTP 403) on 2026-11-14. June 10 is the article's date for the letter. When it was filed on DOB NOW is not known; the 20261111... folder in the link may only be when the portal staged the download.

proof.note: A public source reports this document; nobody here has read it. A lead, not proof.

rows.title: License to enter the adjoining property
rows.requirement: The adjoining owner affords a license to enter; section 3309.4 says who carries the protection duty if they don't.

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

rows.title: Examine the adjoining building
rows.requirement: Once access is granted, physically examine the adjoining property before work and at intervals during it, record the conditions, and make the records available to DOB.

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

rows.title: Protect adjoining footings and foundations
rows.requirement: Whenever soil or foundation work occurs, at any depth, protect adjoining structures, including footings and foundations, at the builder's expense.
rows.proof_needed: The protection design and records that it was installed

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

rows.title: Preconstruction survey
rows.requirement: No excavation 5 to 10 ft deep within 10 ft of an adjacent building, or over 10 ft deep anywhere, until a survey documents the existing conditions of all adjacent buildings.

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

rows.title: Excavation-support drawings
rows.requirement: Means of supporting the excavation shown on construction documents by a design professional with retaining or bracing experience; over 20 ft deep, a NY State PE.

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

basis.detail: 1 DOB NOW filing(s) on this lot list earth work, foundation or support-of-excavation work

rows.title: Geotechnical basis for the support design
rows.requirement: The support drawings rest on site-specific testing, and incorporate the geotechnical report, the evaluation analysis and the preconstruction survey.
rows.proof_needed: The geotechnical report, cross-referenced in the drawings

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

rows.title: Underpin or otherwise support adjoining buildings
rows.requirement: Where underpinning or another method of support is required, provide it at the builder's expense.
rows.proof_needed: Underpinning drawings, and records that they were followed

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

rows.title: Special inspection of underpinning
rows.requirement: Underpinning and other methods of supporting adjacent property are subject to special inspections.

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

rows.title: Investigate exposed adjoining walls
rows.requirement: Where work exposes or breaches an adjoining wall, a design professional investigates its stability and condition, and the wall's integrity is maintained.

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

rows.title: Monitor nearby buildings
rows.requirement: During excavation, monitor buildings within the excavation's maximum depth of its edge (and historic structures within 90 ft), under a plan setting scope, frequency, tolerances and reporting (3309.16).
rows.proof_needed: The monitoring plan and its readings

proof.note: Public data does not hold this document; the responsible party provides it.

dob_complaint_categories.name: DOB complaint category codes, from a list DOB published
dob_complaint_categories.document_date_note: The list carries no full date. Its footer reads 'Rev. 12/18' (a month, no day). The PDF's own metadata says created 2018-12-28 and modified 2019-01-03.

caveats: A row is never marked done from public data: its proof is a document the public record does not hold. 'provided_unverified' means the project team supplied it; nobody checked it. 'reported_not_read' means a public source reports it; nobody here has read it.
related_records sit beside a row; they are not its proof.
Counts, and each complaint's status_at_pull, use status at pull time, not on the as-of date.
dob_311_requests and dob_complaints can count the same complaint twice: never add them.

Complaint category meanings come from a list DOB published, imported by hand (kind manual_import; its status says whether a second person checked it). Disposition meanings come from Open Data (kind public_record). A code either key lacks is a gap, listed under code_keys.
Requirements are paraphrased; read the linked code text before relying on a row.
Nothing here establishes the cause of any incident.
